video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.01.2026

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Mario Hezonja's passing ability in traffic
quotes.excerpt: He's an incredible passer, especially in traffic when there's a lot of bodies around him.
quotes.quote: His passing ability. He's an incredible passer, especially in traffic when there's a lot of bodies around him. He's able to find the open man, and especially for me when I'm in the dunker, he's found me plenty of times where I've had an open, wide-open layup.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen is high on Mario Hezonja's playmaking, noting he is an incredible passer in traffic who consistently finds him for easy looks in the dunker spot.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on team communication and defensive rotations
quotes.excerpt: If he helps up the help, I need to have his back immediately.
quotes.quote: Just communication, being on the same page. If he helps up the help, I need to have his back immediately. It doesn't need to be a question, no hesitation, and vice versa. He needs to have my back when I go help. I think that's our next step.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the next step for the Cavs defense is better communication and immediate rotations, stating that when a teammate helps, he needs to have their back without hesitation.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the impact of Mario Hezonja and Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: They've been incredible in training camp and practice. They're aggressive on the wings.
quotes.quote: We added two great wings with Mario Hezonja and Peyton Watson. They've been incredible in training camp and practice. They're aggressive on the wings. They're able to guard one through five, and Peyton one through four, but we're able to be defenders and just guard.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen is impressed with the defensive versatility of new additions Mario Hezonja and Peyton Watson, noting their ability to guard multiple positions.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on his defensive role of deterring shots
quotes.excerpt: My job is to make sure people second-guess going to the paint.
quotes.quote: Probably just deterring shots and deterring players from driving to the rim. I don't necessarily have to block the shot. My job is to make sure people second-guess going to the paint, and you can't really tell on the stat sheet how many times somebody else thinks about not shooting the ball.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says his defensive goal is to make players second guess driving to the rim, even if he does not record a block, because he wants to deter shots before they happen.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the team's potential to be the best in the East
quotes.excerpt: I think we have every single ability to be the best team in the Eastern Conference.
quotes.quote: I think we have every single ability to be the best team in the Eastern Conference. I think the only thing that will hold us back is if we start questioning our ability to do it.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen believes the Cavs have every ability to be the best team in the Eastern Conference this season, provided they do not start questioning their own potential.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on preparing for Victor Wembanyama and Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: You just have to understand their strengths and weaknesses.
quotes.quote: You just have to understand their strengths and weaknesses. They don't have a lot of weaknesses, but you have to learn what you can exploit when playing against them, where you can attack, where you can try to find somewhere you can slip in and just exploit it.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on preparing for stars like Wembanyama and Jokic: You have to learn what you can exploit because they do not have a lot of weaknesses.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on ignoring trade rumors and noise
quotes.excerpt: I hear the noise, I listen to it, I understand it, but I don't let it impact my life.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, it's not my choice about where I want to go. It's not my choice about a lot of the things I do in my job. I just have to go out there and be the best player I can be, and in the summer, I have to focus on even improving even more. I hear the noise, I listen to it, I understand it, but I don't let it impact my life on and off the court.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says he hears the trade noise but does not let it impact his life, focusing instead on being the best player he can be for the team.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on his playmaking role in the offense
quotes.excerpt: My playmaking ability comes when I catch the ball on the roll.
quotes.quote: My playmaking ability comes when I catch the ball on the roll and have to make the decision out of it. If we're being honest, that's the only time I really get the ball, is off the roll or in specific situations at the top of the key. Every single time I do it, I have to make the right decision because I don't have to get the ball a lot.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on his offensive role: I do not get the ball a lot, so every time I catch it on the roll or at the top of the key, I have to make the right decision.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on his impressions of Khalifa Diop
quotes.excerpt: He came in with smiles on his face, ready to work.
quotes.quote: I got to meet him and he seemed like a great guy. He came in with smiles on his face, ready to work. I know he has the foot injuries that's holding him back a little bit, but everything he can do, he's doing. He wants more, he wants to be able to go out and play.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen provides an update on Khalifa Diop, noting the big man is eager to work despite being held back by foot injuries.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Malik Thomas's defensive development
quotes.excerpt: Something that's impressed me is his ability on defense.
quotes.quote: Something that's impressed me is his ability on defense. He's trying to be one of the better defenders out there, and I'm willing to give him any information he wants. He's getting foul calls on the defensive end. He still has a lot to learn in terms of guarding somebody, but for me, I'm just trying to push him to be in the right direction.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen is impressed by Malik Thomas's defensive effort in camp, noting that he is pushing the young guard to learn the nuances of guarding at the NBA level.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Peyton Watson's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: His switchability and keeping a defender in front of him.
quotes.quote: His switchability and keeping a defender in front of him. There's a lot of times where a defender will drive and instead of him getting blown by, he's hitting the defender and not letting him get by, so Evan Mobley and I don't have to help as much.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen credits Peyton Watson for his ability to keep defenders in front of him, which allows him and Evan Mobley to stay home rather than constantly helping.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the team's defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: We have a lot of guys that are interchangeable.
quotes.quote: We have a lot of guys that are interchangeable. A lot of the times that helps us run different types of defenses. That doesn't put us into something where we have to funnel everything to the bigs like we have in the past. We're able to just let everybody play defense in different positions.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the Cavs' defensive versatility is a major shift, allowing them to run different schemes instead of funneling everything to the bigs.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Mario Hezonja's physical strength
quotes.excerpt: He's able to take a bump and still be able to go straight.
quotes.quote: Very impactful. When he drives to the basket, people are bouncing off of him. He's able to take a bump and still be able to go straight.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen notes the physical impact of Mario Hezonja, saying that when he drives to the basket, people are bouncing off of him.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Mario Hezonja's physical transformation
quotes.excerpt: It hasn't slowed him down. Even though he's so strong, he's still able to be quick.
quotes.quote: It hasn't slowed him down. Even though he's so strong and he has all the muscle on him, he's still able to get around the court, he's still able to be quick. Usually, if you see a guy at that big and move that much, they're sluggish, but not him. He's able to do everything I'm sure he was doing in the past.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Mario Hezonja has maintained his quickness despite his physical transformation, noting he is not sluggish despite the added muscle.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Donovan Mitchell's commitment to the team
quotes.excerpt: It just shows how locked in to the team, to the city, to everything he is.
quotes.quote: It just shows how locked in to the team, to the city, to everything he is. He could have easily waited and signed for more, right? That's how it worked. And he didn't. He shows that this is enough. He's not looking for more money, he's not looking for more incentives. He's looking to have a team that trusts him and being on the team that he trusts.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Donovan Mitchell's decision to sign his extension without waiting for more money shows how locked in he is to the team and the city.
